title: Endless Column (It Arrives Nowhere)
summary: A Shepard-Risset glissando rebuilt as Brancusi's Endless Column: a tone and a stack of modules that rise forever and never get higher.
mechanism: Seven octave-spaced Web Audio oscillators wrapped under a raised-cosine envelope (a live Shepard-Risset glissando) driven by one phase variable that also scrolls a canvas module stack; no samples, no network.
references: Constantin Brancusi, Coloana fara sfarsit (Endless Column), 1938
